topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture's focus on cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the tumor microenvironment alongside the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive Darwinian clonal evolution in tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies, stem cell properties, and cancer stem cell populations influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment and Inflammation in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how external promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions are essential to permit and sustain malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Technologies for Tumor Profiling and Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss experimental profiling methods and synthesize the combined genetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors governing cancer evolution.

topics.label: Concluding Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative closing of the lecture and previews the next session on cancer therapy.
